planting.note: Direct sow or start indoors a few weeks before last frost; also sow in late summer for a fall crop.

directions: This 2026 Burpee introduction is a compact kale bred for small-space growing, reaching maturity in about 45 days. Its densely packed, heavily ruffled leaves pack a lot of texture and nutrition into a small footprint, and hold up well whether eaten raw in salads, cooked into stews, blended into smoothies, or baked into chips. Burpee specifically markets it as a patio, deck, and balcony container variety for gardeners with limited space. Give it full sun and consistent moisture for the best leaf production.

planting.note: Direct sow in warm soil after frost danger has passed; block-plant for good pollination.

directions: New for 2026, Magnolia is an F1 supersweet (SH2) hybrid bred for Southern and hot-climate gardens, with Burpee noting improved disease resistance and heat tolerance to over 100 degrees F. It grows to roughly 80 inches tall and produces pearly-white ears that Burpee describes as exceptionally sweet with a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Direct sow in warm soil after the last frost in blocks of rows rather than a single line to ensure good wind pollination.
sources: Burpee (burpee.com) — Magnolia Sweet Corn product page

planting.note: Start seed indoors 8-10 weeks before last frost; transplant outside once soil is warm and frost danger has passed.

directions: Bonanza is a new-for-2026 F1 hybrid eggplant from Burpee bred for large plants and season-long yields of extra-large fruit, averaging about 6 inches, on plants reaching roughly 5 feet tall and 4 feet wide. Burpee describes the fruit's flavor as rich with a firm yet velvety texture suited to roasting, grilling, or sauteing as a main dish or side. It needs a full growing season of warmth and full sun, so start it indoors and transplant after the soil has warmed.

planting.note: Direct sow after all danger of frost has passed; successive sowings extend bloom.

directions: A new 2026 Burpee introduction, Kindergarten is a dwarf branching sunflower that tops out around 10-14 inches, far shorter than classic garden sunflowers, and covers itself in multiple 3-inch sunny-yellow blooms per plant. Burpee markets it as especially good for small spaces and for children just learning to garden, since the compact plants thrive in window boxes, pots, and tubs as well as garden beds and borders. It wants full sun and direct seeding once the soil has warmed.

planting.note: Start indoors 4-6 weeks before last frost, or direct sow once soil is warm.

directions: Macarenia is one of Burpee's new 2026 zinnias, grown for its spicy-orange 3-inch blooms that deepen in color as the flowers mature, giving a two-tone effect across the bed. Plants reach about 30 inches tall and bloom all summer, making them useful in beds, borders, containers, and cut-flower bouquets. Give it full sun, consistent moisture, and good air circulation to keep the foliage healthy through a long bloom season.
